# Route Troubleshooting

When traffic is not reaching its destination, verify:

1. Source IP
2. Destination IP
3. Source interface
4. Destination route
5. Active next hop
6. Egress interface
7. Next-hop reachability
8. Security zones
9. Security policy
10. NAT behavior
11. Return route
12. Session state
13. Logs

---
